about.title: Laguna Niguel Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Laguna Niguel's mix of busy commercial corridors and residential connectors means collisions happen in predictable spots — Crown Valley Parkway, Golden Lantern, Alicia Parkway, and Moulton Parkway see the heaviest reported crash counts, with Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. showing the most activity. In a recent year, Orange County recorded 107 injury collisions and 142 injured people connected to this area, plus 3 traffic deaths. If you were hurt in one of these crashes, the days right after matter: insurers move fast, and evidence like skid marks, dashcam footage, and witness memory fades quickly. LawProactive isn't a law firm — we're a free service that connects injured Laguna Niguel drivers, passengers, cyclists, and pedestrians with independent personal injury attorneys who handle these cases on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless you recover.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before Talking to the Insurer

items.title: California's Statute of Limitations Won't Wait
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a personal injury claim in California, and that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government entity is involved — for example, a crash tied to a city-maintained intersection along Alicia Parkway. An attorney can help you understand which deadline applies before it passes.

items.title: Pure Comparative Fault Means Partial Blame Isn't the End
items.desc: California lets you recover damages even if you're partly at fault for a crash, with your compensation reduced by your share of responsibility. An independent attorney can help make sure fault isn't overstated against you by the other driver's insurer.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages
items.desc: California doesn't limit compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in most car accident cases. That makes it worth having someone independent evaluate your claim rather than accepting an early settlement offer.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's generally best to avoid giving a recorded statement before speaking with an attorney. Insurers sometimes use these statements to shift blame or minimize your injuries. An independent attorney can advise you on what, if anything, to say.

items.question: What if my crash happened on a road maintained by the city, like near Golden Lantern?
items.answer: Claims involving government-maintained roads can carry a much shorter filing deadline, sometimes as little as six months. If your crash occurred near an intersection maintained by Laguna Niguel or Orange County, it's worth getting an attorney's input quickly to avoid missing that window.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront cost or obligation to move forward.
